citation: Mazarico, E., Neumann, G. A., Smith, D. E., Zuber, M. T., Torrence, M. H. (2011). Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography. Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030. LOLA products V1.05 (2016-09), LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0.
definition: PSR: never illuminated by any part of the solar disc over a lunar nutation cycle (~18.6 years, 1 h step), from LOLA topography.
avg_definition: Average fraction of hourly time steps with any part of the disc visible, same span.
